Sends custom headers on all crawl requests

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'custom_headers' => { 'Accept-Language' => 'en-US', 'X-Custom-Header' => 'test-value' }, 'max_depth' => 1, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages.length.inspect
```
